column1: 1Data produksi daging diperoleh dari total pemotongan  ternak dikalikan rata-rata produksi daging per ekor. Total pemotongan ternak merupakan jumlah pemotongan ternak di RPH/TPH, di luar RPH/TPH yang tercatat, dan di luar RPH/TPH perkiraan yang tidak tercatat. Rata-rata produksi daging per ekor untuk karkas, daging murni/skeletal, dan jeroan berasal dari LPTB BPS, sedangkan rata-rata produksi daging per ekor untuk daging variasi bersumber dari Direktorat Jenderal Peternakan dan Kesehatatan Hewan, Kementerian Pertanian. Jumlah Produksi Daging (Karkas) adalah banyaknya produksi karkas hasil pemotongan ternak ditambah dengan edible portion (bagian yang dapat dimakan) meliputi jeroan dan daging variasi. Jumlah Produksi Daging (Meatyield) adalah banyaknya produksi daging murni/skeletal ditambah dengan edible portion (bagian yang dapat dimakan) meliputi jeroan dan daging variasi./Meat production data are obtained by multiplying the total number of livestock slaughtered by the average meat production per head. The total number of livestock slaughtered consists of slaughtering at slaughterhouses/slaughtering places, recorded slaughtering outside slaughterhouses/slaughtering places, and estimated unrecorded slaughtering outside slaughterhouses/slaughtering places. The average meat production per head for carcass, pure/skeletal meat, and edible offal is derived from the Monthly Livestock Slaughter Report of BPS-Statistics Indonesia, while the average meat production per head for fancy meats is sourced from the Directorate General of Livestock and Animal Health Services, Ministry of Agriculture. Number of Carcass Meat Production is the quantity of carcass production resulting from livestock slaughter added with edible portion including edible offal and fancy meat. Number of Meatyield Production is the quantity of pure/skeletal meat production added with edible portion including edible offal and fancy meat.
